title: BackDoor, Bat Galim Haifa, Israeli Surfing
what_it_shows: Short black-and-white clip of a surfer riding a wave at 'Backdoor,' the reef break at Bat Galim, Haifa, that SurferToday describes as working well with the Med's most powerful swells and offshore winds in winter — a direct visual of the low-swell, wind-swell-dominated conditions this dossier's wave-climate figures describe.

frames.caption: Surfer dropping into a small, steep wave at Backdoor, Bat Galim, Haifa, with a jetty/breakwater visible at the right edge of frame — consistent with the reef-break description in the dossier's surf-spot sources.

title: Israel Surfers 2022 Haifa Bat Galim Beach
what_it_shows: Colour footage at Bat Galim beach, Haifa, showing a kite/windsurfer rigging up on the sand with breaking waves and the rocky breakwater in the foreground and anchored ships of Haifa Bay visible on the horizon — grounds the dossier's WNW-NW wave-direction and modest-height (0.5-1.0 m mean SWH) figures in an actual on-site view, including the wind-driven chop typical of this coast.

frames.caption: Kite/windsurfer kneeling on the sand at Bat Galim beach, Haifa, facing breaking waves with rocky breakwater to the right and Haifa Bay's anchored ships visible offshore.
